audit_method: Read docs/group6/GENESIS_G6_01_PRODUCTION_HARDENING.md and docs/transition/PRODUCTION_HARDENING_MATRIX.md; classify each deferred item

deferred_p1_items.name: Runtime unavailable health check
deferred_p1_items.g6_01_evidence: docs/group6/GENESIS_G6_01_PRODUCTION_HARDENING.md: 'Runtime health check at mission start belongs with the RC reproducibility gate. The ConfigValidator provides the configuration-check half; the runtime-health half is G6-04.'
deferred_p1_items.current_evidence: The clean-room smoke mission uses MemoryComputer (deterministic in-memory stub), not real OpenBot. The 'runtime unavailable' scenario applies to REAL OpenBot/OpenDots/OpenMuse — not to the deterministic core. The ConfigValidator (src/mission/config-validator.ts) provides configuration-level health check; the runtime-health half is not implemented but is not a blocker for deterministic core reproducibility.
deferred_p1_items.resolution_recommendation: Defer to a future hardening phase when real OpenBot is in scope. The deterministic core does not require runtime health checks because MemoryComputer never fails.

deferred_p1_items.name: OpenBot disconnect reconnect logic
deferred_p1_items.g6_01_evidence: docs/group6/GENESIS_G6_01_PRODUCTION_HARDENING.md: 'Reconnect logic requires provider-health infrastructure from G6-04.'
deferred_p1_items.current_evidence: Same as H-07: real OpenBot only. MemoryComputer never disconnects. The deterministic core has no disconnect scenario.
deferred_p1_items.resolution_recommendation: Defer to a future hardening phase when real OpenBot is in scope.

deferred_p1_items.name: Durable job recovery (in-flight)
deferred_p1_items.g6_01_evidence: docs/group6/GENESIS_G6_01_PRODUCTION_HARDENING.md: 'Queued recovery proven (Phase 4.7). In-flight recovery not claimed.'
deferred_p1_items.current_evidence: Queued recovery is proven; in-flight checkpoint resume is NOT claimed. The deterministic core does not use durable jobs at all (MemoryComputer has no durable jobs). The clean-room smoke mission does not invoke OpenMuse.
deferred_p1_items.resolution_recommendation: Defer to a future hardening phase when real OpenMuse in-flight scenarios are in scope.

real_provider_evidence_debt.g6_01_evidence_requirement: G6-01 had incomplete real-provider hardening evidence because a real provider credential was unavailable.
real_provider_evidence_debt.current_evidence: G6-03B supplied real Jev Decision Model (typesafe/jev-1.13) evidence via the OpenRouter Decisions API on the EU region host. The real causal proof PASSES end-to-end. JEV_FINAL_STATUS = OPTIONAL_REAL_INTEGRATION_PROVEN. The G6-01 real-provider evidence debt is therefore resolved (for Jev).
real_provider_evidence_debt.rc_impact: none — Jev is OPTIONAL; the real-provider evidence debt was about Jev specifically, and G6-03B resolved it
real_provider_evidence_debt.other_real_providers: OpenBot, OpenDots, OpenMuse real-provider evidence remains in their respective phase-4 evidence packages (phase-4-5-probe through phase-4-8e-blind). These are not RC blockers because the deterministic core does not require them.

accepted_limitations.evidence: G6-01 H-22: queued recovery proven; in-flight NOT proven. Not a blocker for deterministic core.

summary: All G6-01 deferred P1 items are ACCEPTED_RELEASE_LIMITATION, not RC blockers. The deterministic core does not require real OpenBot/OpenDots/OpenMuse; it uses MemoryComputer. The real-provider evidence debt (Jev) was resolved by G6-03B.
